Hi Marcus / Jordan Events ops team,

Thanks again for taking the site brief last week. We're finalizing the AV plan for the Redwood Exec Workshop at The Meridian on Jul 15-16 and need to lock a few operational items so engineering can prepare the remote bridge and FOH racks. High-level asks below — please confirm availability and share any constraints by EOD Friday so we can circulate the final checklist to the vendors.

Top asks:
- Physical path: confirm main fiber entry point to ballroom riser and on-site fiber punchdown availability (we've attached a rough site_sketch.pdf).
- FOH audio: will the house console provide 16 XLR LR feeds to the FOH rack? Need level & pre/post-fader status.
- Network: is there a dedicated VLAN for the bridge with internet egress 500 Mbps up? If not, can we reserve a private circuit?
- Remote bridge: we plan a Redwood-managed bridge (primary) + backup Zoom bridge. Need room to stage 2 RU of rackspace and power at the FOH riser.
- Test window: request a 2-hour rehearsal/test block at 08:00-10:00 PDT on Jul 14 (day before) — please confirm site crew availability for cable pull and signal checks.

Attachments: site_sketch.pdf, bridge_requirements.xlsx

Notes for internal team: Lauren — we need the VIP suite feed split. Jonas — can you confirm Dante/AES67 mapping once Marcus confirms FOH console details?

Thanks,
Hannah

Hi Hannah — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers from our side and a couple of clarifying Qs: 

- Fiber entry & riser: The Meridian has a single MPO fiber demarc in Loading Dock B; we have 200m of indoor-rated multimode to the ballroom riser. Punchdowns available; we'll include a labeled MPO-to-LC patch in the riser.
- FOH console: The house console is an Avid S6; we can provide 16 XLR LR outs, pre-fader, at nominal line level. We will confirm exact pinout and supply the riser snake.
- Network: Onsite WAN currently provides shared internet; we can provision a private VLAN and reserve symmetric 600 Mbps egress for the two days. Need 48-72 hours lead time to schedule with the carrier.
- Rackspace: We can reserve a 2RU clean rack position at FOH with filtered power (two circuits) and a 1Gbps uplink.
- Test window: Jul 14 at 08:00-10:00 works for our techs; they request a 30-minute earlier vendor access window at 07:30 to stage fiber and snake pulls.

Attachments: venue_riser_map.pdf

Q: For the backup Zoom bridge, do you need a separate public IP or are you happy to NAT through the private VLAN? Also — do you require SDI program outputs to be cross-converted for the remote producer?

Happy to jump on a 20-min call tomorrow if that helps.

—Marcus

Thanks everyone — confirming network stance from Redwood.

- We need a dedicated public IP for the backup Zoom bridge to simplify SDP/port pinning and ensure SRTP traversal. Jordan — can your carrier reserve and route one public IP to the private VLAN for the event? If so, please provide IP & gateway by Tue 16 Jun so we can add NAT/PAT rules.
- Bandwidth: we will reserve 450 Mbps up for the primary Redwood bridge and 150 Mbps for the backup Zoom bridge; that gives us the target 600 Mbps Marcus called out.
- Firewall: if Jordan NATs the secondary bridge, provide the ACL table and the carrier slot we should open for port ranges 50000-65535 UDP (RTP) and TCP 443 for signaling.

I've attached final-test-schedule.ics to this thread (calendar stub). Once Marcus confirms IP provisioning and FOH pinouts we'll finalize the run-of-show and pass to production crews.
